finish.worktree.remoteActions.en: Branch actions run on {computer}, not here.
finish.worktree.remoteActions.zh-CN: 分支操作在 {computer} 上执行，不在本机执行。

finish.worktree.attachDescription.en: This task keeps its draft, harness, and model, and its changes stay in an isolated checkout beside {project}.
finish.worktree.attachDescription.zh-CN: 此任务将保留草稿、运行器和模型，更改将存放在 {project} 旁的独立工作副本中。

finish.worktree.newDescription.en: Start a new task in an isolated checkout of {project}. It inherits this task's harness and model.
finish.worktree.newDescription.zh-CN: 在 {project} 的独立工作副本中开始新任务，并沿用此任务的运行器和模型。

finish.worktree.baseWorktree.en: Local branches load from the worktree checkout.
finish.worktree.baseWorktree.zh-CN: 从工作树的工作副本加载本地分支。

finish.worktree.baseProject.en: Local branches load from the project checkout.
finish.worktree.baseProject.zh-CN: 从项目的工作副本加载本地分支。

finish.worktree.names.en: Names may use letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, and slashes.
finish.worktree.names.zh-CN: 名称可使用英文字母、数字、连字符、下划线和斜杠。

finish.worktree.gone.en: The worktree folder is already gone. {note}
finish.worktree.gone.zh-CN: 工作树文件夹已不存在。{note}

finish.worktree.prunedNote.en: Its registration is pruned and the task is settled.
finish.worktree.prunedNote.zh-CN: 将清理工作树登记信息并结项任务。

finish.worktree.dirtyOne.en: Its worktree has {count} uncommitted change, so the checkout stays at {path}.{action}
finish.worktree.dirtyOne.zh-CN: 工作树有 {count} 项未提交的更改，因此工作副本将保留在 {path}。{action}

finish.worktree.dirtyMany.en: Its worktree has {count} uncommitted changes, so the checkout stays at {path}.{action}
finish.worktree.dirtyMany.zh-CN: 工作树有 {count} 项未提交的更改，因此工作副本将保留在 {path}。{action}

finish.worktree.commitFirst.zh-CN: 请先提交或丢弃这些更改。

finish.worktree.clean.zh-CN: 工作树中没有未提交的更改。

finish.worktree.cleanMerged.en: Its worktree is clean and its branch is merged.
finish.worktree.cleanMerged.zh-CN: 工作树中没有未提交的更改，且其分支已合并。

finish.worktree.cleanUnpublished.en: Its worktree is clean, but {branch} has commits that are not pushed or merged.
finish.worktree.cleanUnpublished.zh-CN: 工作树中没有未提交的更改，但 {branch} 上还有尚未推送或合并的提交。

finish.worktree.removeMerged.en: Remove the worktree folder and delete {branch}
finish.worktree.removeMerged.zh-CN: 移除工作树文件夹，并删除 {branch}

finish.worktree.removeKeep.en: Remove the worktree folder; {branch} is kept until it is merged
finish.worktree.removeKeep.zh-CN: 移除工作树文件夹；{branch} 将保留至合并完成

finish.worktree.removedKept.zh-CN: 已移除工作树；{branch} 已保留

finish.worktree.moved.zh-CN: （项目工作副本已从 {branch} 切换）

finish.worktree.mergedOne.zh-CN: 已将 {count} 个提交从 {branch} 合并到 {target}{moved}

finish.worktree.mergedMany.zh-CN: 已将 {count} 个提交从 {branch} 合并到 {target}{moved}

finish.worktree.upToDate.zh-CN: {target} 已包含 {branch} 的全部内容
